# The Dairy Doctor: Advanced Dairy Diagnostics & Consulting, LLC

> A mail-in veterinary diagnostic lab and herd health consulting practice run by Dr. Glenn Pearson, DVM, in Frederic, Wisconsin. BioPRYN blood pregnancy testing for cattle, bison, goats and sheep, BVD PI testing for cattle and bison, and herd health consulting.

The lab is in Frederic, in northwest Wisconsin near the Minnesota line, and works by mail with herds across the Upper Midwest. The practice opened in 1999 as Dairy Pharm Services and in 2005 became the first BioPRYN affiliate lab east of the Rockies. Every plate is read by the lab's veterinarian. Samples that reach the lab by Wednesday are reported Thursday by email, fax or phone, whichever you mark on the form. Tests run Monday to Thursday. The lab is staffed Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Central. The lab is closed to visitors for biosecurity; samples come by mail. There is no online ordering: farms draw their own samples, fill in the paper submission form and mail the box.

Mail and samples: 362 310th Avenue, Frederic, WI 54837. Phone (715) 653-2201. Fax (715) 653-4301. Email info@dairydoctor.com.

First box? Please call our office before your first submission, at (715) 653-2201, or send the new client form. We'd like to meet you. A call settles which supplies you need.

Home page: [The Dairy Doctor](https://dairydoctor.com/)

## Tests

- [Pregnancy testing](https://dairydoctor.com/pregtest.html): BioPRYN blood test. Cows and bison from 28 days after breeding, virgin heifers from 25 days, goats and sheep from 30 days; cows at least 90 days after calving. Prices are on this page.
- [BVD PI testing](https://dairydoctor.com/bvdtest.html): ear notch or blood, for cattle and bison only, shipped cold. Prices are on this page.
- [How results are read](https://dairydoctor.com/results.html): pregnant, open and recheck, what the veterinarian adds, and the limits of a blood test.

## By herd

- [Beef and bison herds](https://dairydoctor.com/beef.html): testing at the chute or handling system, by mail.
- [Goats and sheep](https://dairydoctor.com/goats.html): pregnancy testing from 30 days after breeding, and the jugular draw step by step.

## Consulting

- [Herd health consulting](https://dairydoctor.com/consulting.html): online consulting by phone and email, from your records and lab results. Herd health and treatment records review and analysis, customized preventive programs and treatment plans, Dairy Comp 305 records consulting, biosecurity program design, disease monitoring programs (BVD, Johne's, Leukosis and Mycoplasma), and personalized training in on-farm procedures like tail bleeding and ear notching.

## Sending samples

- [How to tail bleed](https://dairydoctor.com/tailbleeding.html): step-by-step tail-vein draw for cattle and bison (needle depth about 1/2 inch). Goats and sheep are drawn from the jugular vein; see the goats and sheep page.
- [Packing and shipping](https://dairydoctor.com/shipping_test.html): packing steps, a barn card to print, supplies and a ship-by planner. Number each tube in the order of the form, and write the animal ID on it.
- [Submission forms](https://dairydoctor.com/shipping_test.html#forms): the three paper forms (PDF) that go in the box.
- [Common questions](https://dairydoctor.com/faq.html): timing, samples, results and payment.

## The practice

- [About Dr. Pearson](https://dairydoctor.com/aboutus.html): background and the BioPRYN history.
- [Contact and new clients](https://dairydoctor.com/contact.html): phone, fax, email, address and the new client form.
